name: Sun
intro: The Sun pathway channels purification, light and holy power. It excels at destroying corruption, empowering allies and overwhelming supernatural darkness.

meter.name: Radiance
meter.full: An extra purification removes hostile protection
meter.quirkText: Combat-only purification, healing and holy damage.

ability.name: Courageous Song
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Courageous Song — +12% INT; +12% DEF; Immune to Fear. Passive.

ability.name: Holy Flash
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Holy Flash — Deals 130% INT Holy damage (25% base DEF bypass); Lowers target accuracy by 20 percentage points for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Purification Halo
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Purification Halo — Immediately restores 12% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; Removes Burn, Bleed, Poison, Curse, Curse link, Silenced, Confused, Sleep, Stunned, Frozen, Freeze, Bound; Holy damage and purification build Radiance. At 100 charge, cleanse 1 additional Poison or Curse effect per ally and strip one enemy dark protection.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Notarize
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Notarize — Removes current stat buffs, Guarded, Evade and shields; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 35 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Holy Sun Bolt
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Holy Sun Bolt — Deals 170% INT Holy damage (25% base DEF bypass); An Undead target, or a target with corruption or the Madness Prone trait, takes +40% incoming damage for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 45 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Unshadowed Execution
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Unshadowed Execution — Deals 200% INT Holy damage (25% base DEF bypass); Removes current stat buffs, Guarded, Evade and shields; An Undead target, or a target with corruption or the Madness Prone trait, takes +50% incoming damage for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Exorcism Charter
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Exorcism Charter — Deals 220% INT Holy damage (25% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Silenced for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 70 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Dawn Radiance
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Dawn Radiance — Reduces incoming dark damage by 30% after shields; Reduces incoming shadow damage by 30% after shields. Passive.

ability.name: Purifying Sunfire
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Purifying Sunfire — Targets all enemies; Deals 310% INT Holy damage (25% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 95 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Solar Cataclysm
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Solar Cataclysm — Deals 400% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
